prompt: Priya told me she ___ the wedding invitations before our lunch.
explanation_ru: Приглашения были отправлены до разговора, поэтому после told Present Perfect / Past Simple переходит в Past Perfect (had sent), а не has sent.

prompt: Niamh texted from the shop that she (to choose) the blue curtains by then.
explanation_ru: Выбор был сделан к моменту отправки сообщения (by then), поэтому после глагола texted требуется Past Perfect (had chosen).

prompt: Declan wrote that he has paid the gas bill before our holiday.
answer: Declan wrote that he had paid the gas bill before our holiday.
accepted_answers: Declan wrote that he had paid the gas bill before our holiday.
Declan wrote he had paid the gas bill before our holiday.
Declan wrote that he'd paid the gas bill before our holiday.
Declan wrote he'd paid the gas bill before our holiday.
explanation_ru: После глагола wrote в прошедшем времени Present Perfect (has paid) обязательно сдвигается в Past Perfect (had paid).

prompt: Hugo explained he (not / to like) crowded trains, so he bought a bike.
explanation_ru: После глагола explained в прошедшем времени отрицание в Present Simple (don't like) сдвигается в Past Simple (did not like / didn't like).

prompt: Last year, Keiko told us she ___ her old email account anymore.
explanation_ru: После told нужен сдвиг в Past Simple (didn't use). Частые ошибки — оставлять настоящее время (doesn't use) или ставить прошедшую форму после didn't (didn't used).

prompt: Mateo says he (not / to remember) the café address, so check the map.
explanation_ru: Глагол says стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвига времён нет — используется Present Simple (does not remember).

prompt: Holding a cold mug, Elena mentioned she (to read) a travel magazine for an hour before we rang.
explanation_ru: Действие длилось целый час до нашего звонка, поэтому после mentioned Present Perfect Continuous / Past Continuous переходит в Past Perfect Continuous (had been reading).

prompt: Strange music echoed from the shed all Sunday afternoon. When I opened the door, Gregor laughed and told me he (to repair) his grandfather's old radio since lunch. He explained that he (to test) the volume knob right then. Before I left, he promised he (will / to play) my favourite records once the dial worked.
explanation_ru: Длительный ремонт с обеда (since lunch) передаётся через Past Perfect Continuous (had been repairing), действие в момент разговора — через Past Continuous (was testing), а обещание — через would.

prompt: Tariq texted us, "I have booked a table by the window, and I will meet you outside." → Tariq texted us that …
answer: Tariq texted us that he had booked a table by the window, and he would meet us outside.
accepted_answers: Tariq texted us that he had booked a table by the window, and he would meet us outside.
Tariq texted us that he had booked a table by the window and he would meet us outside.
Tariq texted us that he had booked a table by the window and would meet us outside.
Tariq texted us that he had booked a table by the window, and would meet us outside.
Tariq texted us that he'd booked a table by the window, and he'd meet us outside.
Tariq texted us that he'd booked a table by the window and he'd meet us outside.
Tariq texted us that he'd booked a table by the window and would meet us outside.
Tariq texted us that he'd booked a table by the window, and would meet us outside.
explanation_ru: После глагола texted время Present Perfect (have booked) переходит в Past Perfect (had booked), will сдвигается в would, а местоимения меняются на he и us.

prompt: Did Ingrid assure the guard that she (to lock) the side gate by nine o'clock?
explanation_ru: Действие завершилось к определённому часу в прошлом (by nine o'clock) ещё до разговора, поэтому после assure требуется Past Perfect (had locked).

prompt: "Did anyone speak to Sofia after the workshop?" "Yes, she phoned to say she (to meet) the regional director for the first time. She mentioned that his office (to move) to Leeds that month. She also added that our team (can / to expect) a bigger budget in autumn."
explanation_ru: Встреча произошла до звонка (Past Perfect: had met), переезд шёл в тот период (Past Continuous: was moving), а глагол can после added переходит в could.

prompt: Before boarding, Ewan promised he will print our boarding passes at the kiosk, though the queue looked long.
answer: Before boarding, Ewan promised he would print our boarding passes at the kiosk, though the queue looked long.
accepted_answers: Before boarding, Ewan promised he would print our boarding passes at the kiosk, though the queue looked long.
Before boarding, Ewan promised that he would print our boarding passes at the kiosk, though the queue looked long.
Before boarding, Ewan promised he'd print our boarding passes at the kiosk, though the queue looked long.
Before boarding, Ewan promised that he'd print our boarding passes at the kiosk, though the queue looked long.
explanation_ru: После глагола promised в прошедшем времени нельзя оставлять will — требуется сдвиг в would (would print).

prompt: Smiling proudly, Kasia announced that she ___ the mural before the gallery doors opened.
explanation_ru: Роспись была завершена до открытия галереи и до самого объявления, поэтому после announced нужен Past Perfect (had finished), а не has finished.

prompt: Nobody felt hungry until Omar announced that he (to make) warm cheese toasties and (can / to slice) them for everyone.
explanation_ru: Тосты уже были готовы к моменту объявления (Present Perfect → Past Perfect: had made), а модальный глагол can после announced сдвигается в could.

prompt: Thick fog covered the harbour all Friday morning. Fortunately, Moira texted from the island that she (to catch) the six-o'clock ferry before the delays began. She added that she (to drink) hot tea at the harbour café while waiting for her coach. Whenever we travel together, Moira still tells us that early ferries (to save) half a day.
explanation_ru: Посадка на паром случилась раньше сообщения (had caught), чаепитие шло в момент переписки (was drinking), а после глагола в настоящем времени tells сдвига нет (save).

prompt: Despite the late hour, Jacek insisted that he had already cleaned the bathroom before our guests arrived from Warsaw.
answer: Despite the late hour, Jacek insisted that he had already cleaned the bathroom before our guests arrived from Warsaw.
accepted_answers: Despite the late hour, Jacek insisted that he had already cleaned the bathroom before our guests arrived from Warsaw.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: после глагола insisted в прошедшем времени завершённое ранее действие верно передано через Past Perfect (had already cleaned).

prompt: Pointing at the empty corner, Vera mentioned she (to sell) the oak cupboard to a student and (will / to order) a slim bench instead.
explanation_ru: Пустой угол показывает, что шкаф уже продан к моменту разговора (Past Perfect: had sold), а планы на будущее (will) после mentioned переходят в would.

prompt: Exam week always made the college library feel twice as crowded. At the front desk, Sanjay panicked because his pass failed, though he claimed he (to renew) it in September. The librarian smiled and explained that the IT staff (to update) student accounts that afternoon. These days, Sanjay reminds new students that the front desk (to offer) temporary passes in two minutes.
explanation_ru: Продление в сентябре предшествовало разговору (had renewed), обновление шло в тот день (was/were updating), а после глагола в настоящем времени reminds сдвиг не нужен (offers).

prompt: Lidia watched a local play on Friday and posted a short review on Saturday morning. On Sunday, she told her drama teacher about the review. Which sentence reports this accurately?
options: Lidia told her drama teacher that she writes a short review of the play.
Lidia told her drama teacher that she would write a short review of the play.
Lidia told her drama teacher that she had written a short review of the play.
Lidia told her drama teacher that she was writing a short review of the play.
explanation_ru: Отзыв был написан и опубликован до воскресного разговора, поэтому после told подходит только Past Perfect (had written).

prompt: Surprised by the empty bowl, Hannah swore she (to feed) the ginger cat before leaving and added that the neighbour's dog (never / to climb) through the kitchen window before.
explanation_ru: Кормление произошло раньше момента речи (Past Simple → Past Perfect: had fed), а опыт до этого момента (has never climbed before) также сдвигается в Past Perfect (had never climbed).

prompt: Half a mile from the campsite, our main torch suddenly went dark. Embarrassed, Ronan confessed that he (to replace) only one battery before the hike. His sister Fiona laughed and claimed that her mobile (to hold) plenty of charge for the walk back. Five minutes later, however, she sighed that the warning icon (to flash) red on her screen.
explanation_ru: Замена батарейки до похода требует Past Perfect (had replaced), состояние заряда в момент речи — Past Simple (held), а происходящее в тот миг мигание — Past Continuous (was flashing).
